$comment: Line-count ratchet for files still above the 800-line module budget. Each entry records the largest size the file is currently allowed to have. Entries may only shrink: the check fails if a file exceeds its recorded budget, if a recorded budget is raised relative to git HEAD, or if an entry remains after its file drops under the normal 800-line limit. Delete an entry (and commit the smaller budget) as each file is decomposed.
